reviews.text: Love the texture of this cleanser! It lathers up really well into a soft, rich foam, and you only need a tiny amount. I use it once a day because I feel like twice might be a bit too much. My skin feels super clean after washing, almost squeaky clean!
reviews.zh: 好鍾意呢款潔面產品嘅質地！起泡效果非常好，起嚟嘅泡又軟又濃郁，而且只需要少少分量。我每日用一次，因為我覺得用兩次可能會有少少太多。洗完之後皮膚感覺超級乾淨，幾乎係吱吱聲嗰種乾淨！

reviews.text: Me gusta porque deja mis poros limpios y no reseca mi piel, no se siente acartonado, solo limpio y con poquita cantidad hace suficiente espuma. Yo iba a probar el de Abib, pero leí que reseca mucho la piel y decidí probar este y no me arrepiento y me encanta que está hecho de tomate verde. Por si acaso este producto no viene en cajita
reviews.zh: 我鍾意佢，因為佢令我嘅毛孔乾淨，又唔會令我皮膚乾燥，唔會覺得乾得好似紙咁，只係清潔，而且用少少就起夠泡。我本來想試 Abib 嗰款，但係睇到話會令皮膚好乾，所以我決定試呢款，我唔後悔，而且我好鍾意佢係用青番茄做嘅。提提大家，呢款產品冇盒裝。

reviews.text: I’ve been using this cleanser in my daily routine and really like the rich, fluffy foam it creates. It feels gentle while cleansing and rinses off easily without leaving my skin feeling tight. The 120g tube is also a good size for regular use, and I only need a small amount each time.
reviews.zh: 我每日都用呢款潔面產品，好鍾意佢起嘅濃郁、蓬鬆泡沫。潔面嗰陣感覺好溫和，容易沖走，唔會令皮膚繃緊。120g 嘅軟管大小都適合日常使用，每次只需要少少份量。

reviews.text: I was looking for a whipped one like the Shiseido but I wanted fragrance free, and this does the job perfectly, and not to mention how long it lasts, so little product is needed for a full face foam, I assume this will last a year. Really clean feeling after, not too drying, and perfect for moisturiser and then acives after.
reviews.zh: 我一直想搵一款似 Shiseido 嗰類打發質地嘅潔面產品，但我要無味嘅，而呢款正正啱啱好，而且話說耐用，只需要好少量就可以起一整面嘅泡，我估可以用一年。洗完感覺好乾淨，唔會太乾，用嚟搽保濕霜同之後嘅活性成分都好啱。

reviews.text: I really like the this product and I am on my 3rd tube. It cleans my skin well and very gentle on the skin however can be a bit stripping if a person has dry skin but overall works well and i have seen a difference in my pore size.
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢款產品，而家用緊第三支軟管。佢潔面效果好好，對皮膚都好溫和，不過如果皮膚乾性嘅人用，可能會有少少洗走油脂嘅感覺，但整體效果好好，我見到毛孔大小有改善。

reviews.text: It's good at cutting through grease and clogged pores. It's refreshing to use after a sweaty summer oily day. My skin doesn't feel dry after using it but it's also not the most moisturizing. When I feel like pores are starting to get clogged up and blackheads are making its way back, I like to use this. It gets super foamy and it does have a bit of a sticky texture which in theory should help lift debris.
reviews.zh: 佢好擅長去除油脂同堵塞嘅毛孔。夏天出晒汗、好油嗰日用完好清爽。用完皮膚唔會乾，不過保濕力都唔算最好。當我覺得毛孔開始堵塞，黑頭又開始冒出嚟嗰陣，我就會用呢款。佢起好多泡，質地有少少黏，理論上應該有助帶走污垢。

reviews.text: This one is great for oily skin, doesn’t strip the skin but it does feel a lot cleaner, in combo with their oil as a double cleanse it is a wonderful mix for acne and oily skin. I think that it works wonders on my skin, it’s gentle but effective!
reviews.zh: 呢款對油性皮膚好好，唔會令皮膚脫脂，但係會感覺清潔好多。如果同佢哋嘅潔面油一齊做雙重潔面，就係對暗瘡同油性皮膚嘅一個好好配搭。我覺得佢對我嘅皮膚效果好神奇，溫和但有效！

reviews.text:
the first time I used this, I didn’t like it much. I worked my way through the tube I had and by the end I’d fallen in love. 
It really does have sticky bubbles, it’s pretty hard to rinse off if you use too much. But when you do, you’ll have a super squeaky clean face without a hint of tightening or dryness. It really does keep those pores and sebum in check too.
reviews.zh:
第一次用嗰陣，我唔係好鍾意。但我一直用，用到個軟管都用晒，最後就愛上咗。
佢嘅泡沫真係有點黏，如果用得太多，好難沖走。不過當你沖乾淨之後，會有一張超級乾淨、吱吱聲嘅面，而且一啲繃緊或者乾燥嘅感覺都冇。佢真係可以有效控制毛孔同皮脂。

note: 以下評價由 YesStyle 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
